fit.why: 4 of 6 relevant reviews say the waist is true to size or perfect, matching the shopper's usual 32/size M and their last purchase; 2 reviews note minor issues (waist a bit large, thighs tight) but not enough to overturn the overall trend.

quality.why: Reviews highlight good stretch, comfort and consistent fit with no complaints about material durability or construction.

look.styling_tip: Pair with a fitted shirt for smart‑casual or a tee for everyday wear to make the clean‑look jeans versatile.

what_would_settle_it: measure thigh circumference against product specs

overall.one_line: Jeans generally fit true to size with a slim cut, quality is good, and they work for casual or smart‑casual outfits.
